instruction: Open the touchpad settings and enable tap-to-click functionality.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; pyautogui.press('escape'); import time; time.sleep(0.3)

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling tap-to-click on touchpad via touchpad settings. Initial config sets tap-to-click to false. Agent must navigate settings and enable it. Evaluator verifies tap-to-click is true.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the task requirement: enabling tap-to-click functionality
Getter extracts the correct system state via gsettings command for touchpad tap-to-click setting
Metric uses exact_match which is appropriate for boolean gsettings output (true\n vs false\n)
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct and matches the actual gsettings output format when tap-to-click is enabled
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction
Verification is robust: checks persistent system state (gsettings) rather than transient UI state, which is the correct approach
Postconfig appropriately closes Settings window - does not affect verification since gsettings reads system state, not UI state
